home.headline: Learn a language with real content
home.subhead: Read books, watch videos, tap any word you don't know, see its translation instantly and save it. Every saved word enters a smart spaced-repetition system — it comes back right before you'd forget it.
home.ctaNote: Free to use. Premium removes the daily limits.

features.title: 📖 Learn by reading
items: Books matched to your level (A1 to C2)
Tap an unknown word for an instant translation
Long-press a sentence for its translation and a grammar explanation
Add your own books and study with them

features.title: 🎧 Learn by listening
items: Get used to real speech with subtitled videos
Synced transcript: the current line is highlighted as it's spoken
Tap any word in the transcript to translate and save it
Adjust playback speed to your pace

features.title: 🧠 Memorize vocabulary
items: Spaced repetition (SRS): words return exactly when you need them
Learn Mode: multiple choice, writing, fill-in-the-blank
Attach images to your words to remember them better

features.title: ✏️ Practice grammar
items: Save sentences from what you read and watch
Reinforce them with sentence-ordering, quizzes and matching
Read grammar explanations in your native language

home.uiLanguages: App interface: English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German
home.premiumBody: LearnGuage is free to use. Free accounts get a daily allowance that is spent while unlocking book sections and watching listening content.
premiumItems: Premium removes the daily limits on reading and listening
Full access to every book and video in the catalogue
The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial
Cancel any time in Google Play → Subscriptions
home.premiumPriceNote: Prices are shown inside the app in your local currency, and the price displayed at the time of purchase applies.

faq.a: Yes. You can read, listen, and study vocabulary for free within a daily allowance. Premium removes those daily limits.
English, Spanish, German and French. The app interface is available in English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, French and German.

faq.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a: Open Google Play → Subscriptions and cancel there. You keep Premium until the end of the period you already paid for.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: In the app: Settings → Account → Delete Account. If you can't access the app, see the account deletion page.

faq.q: Does the app record audio or track my location?
faq.a: No. LearnGuage does not access your microphone or location, and contains no third-party advertising. See the privacy policy.

faq.q: Can I study with my own books?
faq.a: Yes. You can add your own books and use the same tap-to-translate and word-saving tools with them.

blocks.p: {{app}} is a language-learning mobile application. This policy explains what data the app collects, why, and how you can control it. Contact: {{emailLink}}

ul: Email address and password (password is stored only in hashed form by our authentication provider)
Display name and chosen avatar
Selected native and target languages, self-assessed proficiency level
Saved words and sentences you add while studying, including optional images attached to words
Study statistics (streaks, correct-answer counts, memorized word counts)
Reading and listening progress (which book/video you are on and how far you got)
Reading preferences (font size, theme)
No microphone/audio recordings
No location data
No contacts, photos, or files beyond images you explicitly attach to saved words
No advertising identifiers; the app contains no third-party advertising
No payment card details — subscription payments are processed entirely by Google Play; we never see or store card information

blocks.p: Data is used solely to provide the app's functionality: signing you in, syncing your learning progress across sessions and devices, and showing your own statistics back to you. We do not sell data, do not use it for advertising, and do not share it with third parties except the service providers below.

ul: Supabase — authentication, database, and file storage for the data listed above.
Google Play — app distribution and subscription billing.
RevenueCat — subscription status management on top of Google Play billing.

blocks.p: Your data is kept while your account exists. You can delete your account and all associated data yourself at any time from the app: Settings → Account → Delete Account. Deletion takes effect immediately. If you can no longer access the app, email {{emailLink}} from the address registered to your account; deletion is then completed within 30 days. See the account deletion page for details.
Data is transmitted over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS). Server-side access is restricted with row-level security so that each user can only access their own data.
{{app}} is intended for general audiences and does not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child provided us data, contact us and we will delete it.
This website is a set of static pages. It uses no cookies, no analytics and no tracking of any kind.
We may update this policy; the effective date above will change and material changes will be communicated in the app.
By downloading or using {{app}} ("the app"), you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the app. Contact: {{emailLink}}
{{app}} is a language-learning application offering reading, listening, vocabulary and grammar practice. Free use is subject to daily usage limits. Premium removes those limits.

ul: You must provide a valid email address and keep your credentials secure.
You are responsible for activity that occurs under your account.
You may delete your account at any time from the app (Settings → Account) or via this page.
Premium is offered as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, sold through Google Play.
The price shown in the app at the time of purchase applies. Prices may change; any change applies only to future renewal periods and is announced beforehand.
Auto-renewal: your subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Cancellation: manage or cancel at any time in Google Play → Subscriptions. Cancelling stops future renewals; you keep Premium until the end of the paid period.
Refunds are handled by Google Play according to Google's refund policy.
If a free trial is offered, cancelling before the trial ends prevents any charge.

blocks.p: Free accounts receive a limited number of daily "lives" that are consumed while reading book sections and watching listening content. Lives reset daily. These limits may be adjusted to keep the service sustainable; adjustments never affect an active Premium subscription.

ul: Books in the catalogue are either original works created for {{app}} or public-domain works whose copyright has expired.
Listening content consists of third-party videos played through the official YouTube player; those videos belong to their respective owners.
You may not copy, redistribute or resell app content outside the app.
Content you add yourself (your own books, words, notes) remains yours.

blocks.p: You agree not to: reverse engineer the app, bypass usage limits or payment mechanisms, upload unlawful or infringing content, or disrupt the service for other users.

The app is provided "as is". We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or that the learning content is free of errors. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the app.
These terms may be updated. Material changes will be announced in the app or on this page with a new effective date. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye. Your statutory consumer rights are not affected.

blocks.h2: 1. Delete your account inside the app (recommended)

blocks.p: You can delete your account and all associated data yourself, instantly, from within the app:

ol: Type the confirmation word shown on screen and confirm

blocks.p: Deletion takes effect immediately and cannot be undone.

If you can no longer access the app (lost device, forgotten password, uninstalled app), send a deletion request to {{emailLink}} from the email address registered to your {{app}} account, with the subject "Account deletion request". Your account and data will be deleted within 30 days at the latest, and you will receive a confirmation reply.

ul: Profile information (display name, email link, avatar)
All learning data (saved words and sentences, progress, language-pair data, daily study records, statistics)
Images you attached to saved words (removed from file storage)
Subscription record held by the app (note: to stop billing, also cancel the subscription in Google Play → Subscriptions — deleting the account does not cancel a Google Play subscription)
The authentication account itself

blocks.p: Deletion is permanent and irreversible. No additional copies of your personal data are retained after deletion. Books/PDFs you added yourself are stored only on your device and are removed when the app's data is cleared.
Questions, bug reports and suggestions: {{emailLink}}
Please write in English or Turkish, and include your device model, Android version and the app version (Settings → About) if you are reporting a problem. Replies usually take 1–3 business days.

blocks.h2: I bought Premium but the app still shows limits

blocks.p: Open the app and pull down to refresh, or sign out and back in — the subscription is verified against Google Play on start-up. If it still doesn't unlock after a few minutes, email us with the Google Play order number and we will look into it.

blocks.h2: How do I restore a purchase on a new device?

blocks.p: Sign in with the same account you used when purchasing, then use Restore purchases on the subscription screen. The subscription is tied to your Google account, so make sure you are signed in to Google Play with the account that made the purchase.

blocks.h2: How do I cancel or get a refund?

blocks.p: Cancel any time in Google Play → Subscriptions. Cancelling stops future renewals; Premium continues until the end of the period you already paid for. Refunds are handled by Google Play under Google's refund policy.
On the sign-in screen, tap Forgot password and enter your email address. A reset link will be sent to you. If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder.

blocks.h2: How do I delete my account?

blocks.p: In the app: Settings → Account → Delete Account. Full details, including how to request deletion by email if you can't access the app, are on the account deletion page.
If a book, video or translation is wrong or inappropriate, email us with the title and, if possible, a screenshot. Content reported this way is reviewed and corrected or removed.
